name: Alexis Harper
title: Chief Innovation Officer
bio: Introducing Alexis Harper, our visionary Chief Innovation Officer. With an artistic flair and an eye for the extraordinary, Alexis has played a pivotal role in shaping our eyewear collections. Her innovative designs seamlessly blend fashion and functionality, setting new trends in the industry. Alexis' commitment to crafting eyewear that not only enhances vision but also makes a bold style statement has positioned our brand at the forefront of chic and sustainable eyewear. Explore the world of eyewear through Alexis imaginative lens and witness the fusion of elegance and innovation at Clarity.

name: Allison Fox
title: VP Creative Design
bio:
Allison Fox is the Vice President of Creative Design at Clarity Vision Solutions, a premier eyewear manufacturer known for its cutting-edge and stylish products. With over 15 years of experience in the design industry, Allison is a creative powerhouse whose visionary approach has significantly shaped the company’s product offerings.

Allison joined Clarity Vision Solutions in 2017 and has been instrumental in driving the creative direction and innovation of the company’s eyewear collections. Her keen sense of style, combined with a deep understanding of market trends, has helped the company develop products that resonate with a diverse customer base. Under her leadership, the design team has introduced several iconic and award-winning collections, establishing Clarity Vision Solutions as a trendsetter in the eyewear industry.

Before her role at Clarity Vision Solutions, Allison held senior design positions at several leading fashion and accessory brands. She holds a Bachelor’s degree in Fashion Design from the Parsons School of Design and a Master’s degree in Product Design from the Royal College of Art.

Allison is known for her innovative design concepts, attention to detail, and ability to inspire and lead creative teams. She is passionate about exploring new materials and technologies to push the boundaries of traditional eyewear design, ensuring that Clarity Vision Solutions remains at the forefront of the industry.

In her free time, Allison enjoys sketching, traveling, and discovering new art forms. She is also actively involved in design communities and enjoys mentoring young designers, sharing her knowledge and experience to foster the next generation of creative talent.

name: Brandon O'Quinn
title: Chief Executive Officer
bio:
Brandon O’Quinn is the Chief Executive Officer at Clarity Vision Solutions, a leading eyewear manufacturer celebrated for its innovative designs and exceptional quality. With over 20 years of experience in the industry, Brandon is a visionary leader who has played a pivotal role in shaping the company’s strategic direction and driving its growth.

Brandon joined Clarity Vision Solutions in 2014 and has since transformed the company into a market leader through his strategic vision and dynamic leadership. His focus on innovation, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction has led to significant advancements in product development and market expansion. Under his guidance, Clarity Vision Solutions has achieved remarkable milestones, including several industry awards and a loyal global customer base.

Before his tenure at Clarity Vision Solutions, Brandon held executive positions at various top-tier companies in the consumer goods sector, where he developed a deep expertise in corporate strategy, business development, and operational management. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration from Harvard University and an MBA from Stanford Graduate School of Business.

Brandon is known for his strategic acumen, inspirational leadership, and commitment to fostering a culture of innovation and excellence. He is passionate about leveraging cutting-edge technology and design to create products that enhance the lives of customers worldwide.

In his free time, Brandon enjoys sailing, reading, and supporting various philanthropic causes. He is also an active participant in industry forums and enjoys mentoring emerging leaders in the business community.

name: Chelsea Lane
title: Director of HR
bio:
Chelsea Lane is the Director of Human Resources at Clarity Vision Solutions, a leading eyewear manufacturer known for its commitment to innovation and quality. With over 15 years of experience in human resources, Chelsea is a seasoned professional dedicated to fostering a positive and productive workplace culture.

Chelsea joined Clarity Vision Solutions in 2020 and has been instrumental in developing and implementing HR strategies that support the company’s growth and success. Her expertise in talent acquisition, employee engagement, and organizational development has helped build a dynamic and motivated workforce. Under her leadership, the HR team has introduced several initiatives aimed at enhancing employee well-being and professional development.

Before her role at Clarity Vision Solutions, Chelsea held key HR positions at various multinational corporations, where she developed a deep understanding of best practices in human resource management. She holds a Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources Management from the University of Texas and a Master’s degree in Organizational Psychology from Columbia University.

Chelsea is known for her strategic mindset, excellent communication skills, and ability to build strong relationships across all levels of the organization. She is passionate about creating an inclusive and supportive work environment where employees can thrive and contribute to the company’s mission of delivering exceptional eyewear products to customers worldwide.

In her free time, Chelsea enjoys yoga, traveling, and volunteering at local community organizations. She is also an advocate for diversity and inclusion in the workplace and frequently participates in industry conferences and workshops to share her insights and experiences.

name: Clara Murphy
title: VP of Marketing
bio:
Clara Murphy is the Vice President of Marketing at Clarity Vision Solutions, a premier eyewear manufacturer renowned for its innovative and stylish products. With over 12 years of experience in marketing and brand management, Clara is a strategic leader known for her expertise in driving brand growth and customer engagement.

Clara joined Clarity Vision Solutions in 2019 and has since played a key role in elevating the company’s brand presence in the market. Her creative marketing strategies and data-driven approach have significantly increased brand awareness and customer loyalty. Under her leadership, the marketing team has successfully launched several high-impact campaigns that have positioned Clarity Vision Solutions as a leader in the eyewear industry.

Before her role at Clarity Vision Solutions, Clara held senior marketing positions at various well-known consumer goods companies, where she honed her skills in digital marketing, market research, and campaign management. She holds a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing from the University of Southern California and an MBA from the Kellogg School of Management at Northwestern University.

Clara is celebrated for her innovative thinking, strong analytical skills, and ability to build and lead high-performing teams. She is passionate about creating meaningful connections between brands and consumers and is dedicated to driving Clarity Vision Solutions’ mission of delivering exceptional eyewear products to a global audience.

In her free time, Clara enjoys hiking, photography, and exploring new culinary experiences. She is also actively involved in industry associations and enjoys mentoring young professionals in the field of marketing.

name: Daniel Lewis
title: Chief Creative Officer
bio:
Daniel Lewis is the Chief Creative Officer at Clarity Vision Solutions, a leading eyewear manufacturer known for its innovative and stylish designs. With over 18 years of experience in the creative industry, Daniel is a visionary leader who brings a unique blend of artistic talent and strategic thinking to his role.

Since joining Clarity Vision Solutions in 2016, Daniel has been at the forefront of the company’s creative direction, driving the design and development of groundbreaking eyewear collections. His keen eye for detail and deep understanding of fashion trends have helped Clarity Vision Solutions establish a distinct brand identity and a loyal customer base. Under his leadership, the design team has introduced several award-winning products, setting new standards in the eyewear industry.

Before his tenure at Clarity Vision Solutions, Daniel held prominent creative roles at various prestigious fashion and accessory brands. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Fine Arts from the Rhode Island School of Design and a Master’s degree in Industrial Design from the Pratt Institute.

Daniel is celebrated for his innovative approach to design, his ability to inspire and lead creative teams, and his commitment to excellence. He is passionate about pushing the boundaries of traditional eyewear design, incorporating cutting-edge materials and technologies to create products that are both functional and aesthetically pleasing.

In his free time, Daniel enjoys painting, traveling, and exploring new art forms. He is also an active participant in design conferences and workshops, sharing his knowledge and insights with the broader creative community.

name: Diego Morales
title: Chief Sales Officer
bio:
Diego Morales is the Chief Sales Officer at Clarity Vision Solutions, a renowned manufacturer of cutting-edge eyewear products. With over 15 years of experience in the sales industry, Diego is a dynamic leader known for his exceptional ability to drive sales growth and develop high-performing teams.

Diego joined Clarity Vision Solutions in 2018 and has since been pivotal in expanding the company’s market presence and boosting revenue. His strategic vision and customer-centric approach have enabled the company to forge strong relationships with key clients and partners, leading to increased market share and customer loyalty. Under his leadership, the sales team has consistently exceeded targets and delivered outstanding results.

Before his tenure at Clarity Vision Solutions, Diego held senior sales positions at several leading consumer goods companies, where he developed a deep understanding of market dynamics and honed his skills in sales strategy, negotiation, and team management. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration from the University of Barcelona and a Master’s degree in Marketing from ESADE Business School.

Diego is recognized for his innovative sales strategies, strong interpersonal skills, and unwavering dedication to achieving excellence. He is passionate about mentoring and developing his team, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement at Clarity Vision Solutions.

Outside of work, Diego enjoys cycling, traveling, and exploring new cultures. He is also actively involved in various industry associations and enjoys giving back to the community through volunteer work and charitable initiatives.

name: Nigel Cook
title: Chief Financial Officer
bio:
Nigel Cook is the Chief Financial Officer at Clarity Vision Solutions, a leading manufacturer of innovative and stylish eyewear. With over 20 years of experience in the finance industry, Nigel brings a wealth of knowledge and expertise to his role, overseeing the company’s financial operations and strategies.

Nigel joined Clarity Vision Solutions in 2015 and has been instrumental in driving the company’s financial growth and stability. His strategic financial planning and keen insight into market trends have helped Clarity expand its market share and enhance its profitability. Under his leadership, the company has implemented robust financial controls and reporting systems, ensuring transparency and efficiency in all financial activities.

Before joining Clarity, Nigel held senior financial positions at several multinational corporations, where he honed his skills in financial management, budgeting, and risk assessment. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting from the University of Manchester and an MBA from London Business School.

Nigel is known for his analytical acumen, strong leadership, and commitment to fostering a culture of financial excellence. He is passionate about leveraging financial data to drive business decisions and is dedicated to supporting Clarity's mission of delivering high-quality eyewear products to customers worldwide.

In his free time, Nigel enjoys reading, traveling, and exploring new culinary experiences. He is also an avid supporter of various charitable causes and actively participates in community service initiatives.
